items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 11:1
items.html: (To the question) When Aba and Ima are in the stature of SAG, the Keter of Aba is found higher than the Keter of Ima, for Ima, who is Bina, is discerned as having emerged from the head of AA; but the aspect of Aba did not emerge from the head of AA, from the root of his emanation. However, when they are in the stature of AB, when Bina also returns to the head of AA, then they are equal to one another. (Item 6 and in the Inner Light, s.v. and there is no).
